reason: I'm applying to Canada and France and every offer wants a different CV, so if the free action really gives me a better score and a ready cover letter, 500 FCFA is less than one data top-up and I'd pay it once to try more offers. But I'd only take the small pack, not more.

would_change_my_mind: If the free try gives me something no better than ChatGPT, I stop and never pay.
